title: 50th Anniversary Cake Cutting, 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid black-and-white square snapshot from the 1960s capturing an elderly couple celebrating their 50th golden wedding anniversary. The husband and wife hold a knife together to cut a white tiered anniversary cake decorated with a '50' topper. Two young grandchildren stand on either side of the table watching the moment intently. The woman wears a dress adorned with a floral corsage, and the gentleman wears a dark suit with a wide patterned tie and lapel boutonnieres.
